Role

Software Engineer on the Internal Developer Platform team. Built and maintained the infrastructure that Harness used to develop, test, and ship the Harness platform to customers.

The Work

Internal Developer Platform

CI/CD Pipeline Automation:

  • Built deployment pipelines that ship Harness platform updates to production
  • Designed blue-green deployment strategy for zero-downtime releases
  • Implemented automated rollback based on health metrics and error rates
  • Created pipeline templates that reduced deployment configuration time by 60%

Infrastructure Management:

  • Managed multi-region AWS infrastructure supporting 1000+ customer environments
  • Built Terraform modules for provisioning customer sandbox environments
  • Implemented infrastructure-as-code patterns that enabled self-service environment provisioning
  • Designed cost optimization strategies that reduced cloud spend by 30%

Container Orchestration

Kubernetes Cluster Management:

  • Managed production Kubernetes clusters serving customer workloads
  • Designed cluster autoscaling policies for variable workload patterns
  • Implemented resource quotas and limit ranges for multi-tenant isolation
  • Built Helm charts for deploying Harness components to Kubernetes

Developer Experience

Tooling & Automation:

  • Built CLI tools that streamline developer workflows
  • Implemented pre-commit hooks and local development environment setup
  • Created documentation and runbooks for common operational tasks
  • Designed onboarding scripts that reduce new developer ramp-up time

Impact

  • Reduced deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes with automated pipelines
  • Managed infrastructure supporting 1000+ customer environments
  • Built self-service provisioning that eliminated 80% of developer environment requests
  • Implemented cost optimization saving $50K+ annually in cloud spend

Stack

AWS, Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Java, TypeScript, React, Go, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, Helm, ArgoCD
